sentences.en: I proposed to Helen that we have a tea party.
sentences.zh: 我提议海伦我们举办一个茶会。

sentences.en: The solution he proposed was completely out of the question.
sentences.zh: 他提出的解决方案完全行不通。

sentences.en: She proposed that a doctor should be called in immediately.

senses.zh: 提议；计划（propose的过去式和过去分词）
